DACA recipients - you can now sign up for health coverage through the Affordable Care Act from November 1 - January 15!

Learn more & apply at https://t.co/wwuf9FMcPV https://t.co/N4Elx835bL

ICYMI: I introduced my first bill of the 119th Congress! The ARC Act will lower costs for high-risk patients, help those on Medicare and Medicaid get the care they need, and fight unnecessary amputations. https://t.co/m6SIYgn0Ns

I am proud to introduce the ARC Act. 

This bill will save lives and reduce amputations by ensuring high-risk patients have access to PAD screenings, at no additional cost. https://t.co/66Y6k8FkF7

H.R.21 criminalizes doctors giving life saving care, worsens the terrifying conditions of a life-threatening pregnancy, and forces doctors to choose between their patients and the law. 

I joined @DemWomenCaucus & @ReproCaucus to vote NO

Today is National Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day. It's crucial that we commit to expanding access to HIV prevention methods, care, and treatment. As a member of the HIV/AIDS Caucus, I’m fighting to make HIV/AIDS medication more available, for anyone who needs it.

Republicans’ budget will devastate seniors, families, and people across our district.

In NJ-10 alone, this bad bill would: 
 
🚨Steal Medicaid coverage from 225,766 people 
🚨Rip away benefits from 144,000 SNAP users
🚨Raise healthcare premiums by 55% for 30,000 ACA recipients
 
I will vote hell no on this bill.

Trump says we are in a “golden age”. 

Did he ask the people who can’t afford groceries, the patients who can’t afford their medicine, or the parents who can’t afford childcare?

In the wealthiest country on Earth, 770,000 people should not be homeless. 

Gutting critical programs and firing HUD employees—like Trump and Musk are doing—will only cause more people to be without a safe place to sleep.

Glad to join @SenatorAndyKim and @RepMenendez yesterday to fight for our federal workers.

At @PPFA in East Orange, Medicaid is essential for keeping patients safe and healthy. I toured the facility last week to meet with their dedicated staff and discuss their vital services. https://t.co/lJAxJF8tA7

Healthcare is a human right. On World Health Day, I am proud to reaffirm my commitment to providing accessible, affordable, and high-quality care for all Americans. 

Earlier this year, I introduced the ARC Act to ensure that high-risk patients could access the screenings they need to take control of their health.

Healthcare is a human right. 

Last weekend, I visited Liberty Park's DaVita Dialysis Center to discuss the challenges patients face accessing healthcare and how we can make healthcare more accessible for everyone. https://t.co/CVFz0qIw9V

The mobile clinic partnership between @CityofNewarkNJ and @RutgersU is a powerful step toward ensuring the unhoused have direct access healthcare services.

By meeting people where they are we can do more than provide treatment—we can provide dignity and hope.

https://t.co/6Z4a9UTZoA

Had the privilege of visiting @Newark_Beth!

Thank you to the dedicated healthcare workers who provide top-notch care to young patients and their families. Your work is making a difference and I have your back in Congress! 🏥 https://t.co/07omC6loIa

Abortion is healthcare. Period. These critical treatment provisions Trump is stripping protect patients in emergencies. Trump is once again putting people’s lives and health in danger. 
 
Healthcare decisions belong between women and their doctors—always.

https://t.co/MUXzdKbMeI

The treatment of @SenAlexPadilla and the way he was handled is disgraceful. It marks a deeply sad moment for our country. Yet, this administration keeps escalating more each and every day. https://t.co/QW5KDx002S

Oversight is a core responsibility of Congress. We’re urging a congressional investigation into the reports of disturbing treatment of individuals detained at Delaney Hall.

The safety, dignity, and rights of individuals in federal custody must be preserved at all times. https://t.co/fEQnvzXXNo

Slashing funding for the LGBTQ+ crisis hotline is a heartbreaking blow. NJ counselors warn these cuts will cost lives. When people have the strength to ask for help, we must stand with them, and against policies that put our community’s mental health—and lives—on the line.

https://t.co/d8ElEr17Yx

Last week, Team McIver met with @4kira4moms to discuss real solutions that will protect Black maternal health and reduce fatalities. Every mother deserves quality care and support, and there is more we can do to help make that a reality. When moms thrive, we all do. https://t.co/xWLAT3sISM

Happy Small Business Saturday! Today, I visited SweatHouz Therapy Studio and Everbowl in Garwood, two businesses that focus on health and wellness. Appreciative of small businesses that help each of us thrive in NJ-10! https://t.co/woRfdZAglj

This Men's Health Month, let’s raise awareness about the importance of physical and mental health for men of all ages. Encouraging regular check-ups and breaking stigma around mental wellness saves lives. https://t.co/D4pAadAvtx

Republicans are strategizing on how they can give their ultra-rich friends ANOTHER tax break while millions of lives hang in the balance. 16+ million people would lose healthcare access, but Republicans are telling them that they just don’t care. 

https://t.co/Aefpfd0t9g
My next amendment would prohibit funding for surveillance, investigations, and prosecutions of women’s reproductive health decisions. These decisions are between patient and doctor. Period.

My next amendment would prohibit funding increases or decreases at agencies that have carried out mass layoffs of our federal workforce. Our federal workers deserve much better treatment and we can’t give DOGE a blank check.
Let’s break this big UGLY Republican bill down by the numbers. If signed into law, it will rip $3.3 billion from hospitals and public health funding in New Jersey alone. https://t.co/UD8QNk2NpP
360,000. That’s how many of our neighbors in New Jersey will lose healthcare coverage with the Republicans’ bad budget bill. https://t.co/sientO3cHp
